look_here_first: Look at leaf SIZE and flower SHAPE together: a wiry desert twiner with very small 0.5–2 cm leaves and tiny bell-shaped flowers with short triangular (2–3 mm) corolla lobes. Confirm the five-ridged cup-shaped corona at magnification.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Slender, drought-deciduous, suffrutescent twining plant; shoots roughly 10–150 cm

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Small ovate to lanceolate or deltate leaves, approximately 0.5–2 cm long

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Very small campanulate brown/maroon-to-green flowers, not strongly net-reticulate

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Short deltate corolla lobes approximately 2–3 mm long

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Cup-shaped corona with five ridges; inspect style apex at close range

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Narrow follicle about 5–9 cm long, nearly smooth to sparsely tuberculate

lookalikes.differences: Flower and corona characters plus leaf dimensions are more reliable than flower color alone. Photograph leaf and flower beside a ruler.
